thread:
erin: Noticed an onboarding flake: sampleapp hits 401s intermittently when using the Node SDK with short-lived ephemeral keys. Direct REST with the same ephemeral token works reliably. Anyone seen header stripping on refresh?

matt: I can repro. SDK auto-refresh flow requests a new ephemeral token and then retries the original request but the Authorization header is missing on the retry. Server logs show original request with token, refresh succeeds, retry arrives without header -> 401.

hira: That's bad. Quick check: which runtime/version?

matt: node-sdk v1.4.3 + runtime v0.9. The refresh flow is in sdk-runtime.requestRetry(). Looks like a bug where we rebuild the request but forget to copy over custom headers (Authorization, x-request-id).

erin: Two user-visible symptoms: (1) clients see occasional 401s even though token is valid; (2) the SDK classifies 401 as retriable and will retry three times, which results in extra refresh calls and throttling on the auth service. REST clients treat 401 as non-retriable.

hira: Ok we need three things: (A) fix the request rebuild to preserve Authorization and any whitelisted headers; (B) align retry classifier to not retry 401/4xx by default; (C) add an integration test that simulates ephemeral refresh and asserts header preserved.

matt: Minimal repro in Node: 
```js
// will trigger ephemeral refresh if token expires mid-flight
await client.generate({model: 'rwd/fast', input: 'hello'});
```
I captured the dev-proxy: initial request had 'Authorization: Bearer ephemeral:abc', server 401 triggers refresh, refresh call returns new token, retry outbound shows no Authorization header.

erin: Short-term mitigation: sampleapp will pin to a long-lived test API key for onboarding so CI doesn't flake. Patch ready to land in the sampleapp repo. We'll revert after SDK fix.

hira: Also noticed param drift: the SDK auto-refresh endpoint uses query param `scope` (camelCase) while REST expects `scopes[]` array. The refresh succeeded in this repro because auth service tolerates both, but we should standardize. Add generator mapping for auth namespace so query param casing matches REST form.

matt: Good call. I'll patch the runtime to (1) copy Authorization header on retries, (2) change retry policy to treat 4xx as permanent except 429, and (3) update auth generator mapping to emit scopes as `scopes[]` form. Tests for each.

erin: Filed ticket: https://redwood.internal/p/SDK-DX-999 (auth header preservation + retry parity + auth param mapping).

ci-bot: CI: PR #6001 created by matt  unit tests queued.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled for staging once tests pass.

hira: One nuance: some internal endpoints use 401 as a transient signal during token rotation. We'll add per-endpoint metadata to mark exceptions, but default must match REST semantics (don't retry 4xx).

matt: I'll add an allowlist in the runtime config for endpoints that should still be retried on 401/409 with a comment and tests.

erin: Thanks — sampleapp hotfix merged. Ping once PRs green and we can revert the long-lived key. :thumbsup:
